title: DEX string length prefix in UTF-16 code units
summary: The utf16_size of the DEX string_data_item is the ULEB128-encoded UTF-16 length; subsequent strings are in Modified UTF-8.
applies: Android DEX files and Dalvik instructions
detail: Supplementary-plane characters require two UTF-16 code units. U+0000 has a distinct modified encoding, and a zero byte terminates the string.
boundary: The length value cannot be directly used as the number of subsequent encoding bytes; ordinary UTF-8 decoders may not be able to accept the modified encoding of DEX.
relevance: Explain why the next DEX string is not aligned after reading the emoji.
